hypotheses.H1_behavior: The learned rank-256 quotient recovers at least 70% of the exact blend's FineWeb KL improvement over the language CP baseline.
hypotheses.H2_causal: The learned rank-256 quotient recovers at least 70% of the exact blend's FineWeb causal-fidelity improvement for both interventions without falling below baseline.
hypotheses.H3_transfer: The learned rank-256 quotient improves KL and both causal fidelities over baseline on at least two of three evaluation corpora.
hypotheses.H4_beats_pca: The learned rank-256 quotient has lower mean KL and higher mean causal fidelity than hybrid PCA rank 256 across the three corpora.
